import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/coffee_sales.csv')

# Create a figure with multiple subplots for comprehensive insights
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16, 10))

# Define color palette
colors = sns.color_palette("husl", 8)

# 1. Sales by Product (Top left)
ax1 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 1)
product_sales = df.groupby('product')['total'].sum().sort_values(ascending=False)
product_sales.head(8).plot(kind='bar', ax=ax1, color=colors)
ax1.set_title('Total Sales by Product', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_xlabel('Product', fontsize=10)
ax1.set_ylabel('Total Sales ($)', fontsize=10)
ax1.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# 2. Sales Distribution by Customer Age Group (Top middle)
ax2 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 2)
age_sales = df.groupby('customer_age_group')['total'].sum().sort_values(ascending=False)
age_order = ['18-24', '25-34', '35-44', '45-54', '55+']
age_sales_ordered = age_sales.reindex([x for x in age_order if x in age_sales.index])
ax2.pie(age_sales_ordered.values, labels=age_sales_ordered.index, autopct='%1.1f%%', 
        colors=sns.color_palette("Set2", len(age_sales_ordered)), startangle=90)
ax2.set_title('Sales Distribution by Age Group', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')

# 3. Payment Method Distribution (Top right)
ax3 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 3)
payment_counts = df['payment_method'].value_counts()
ax3.bar(payment_counts.index, payment_counts.values, color=sns.color_palette("muted", len(payment_counts)))
ax3.set_title('Transaction Count by Payment Method', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_xlabel('Payment Method', fontsize=10)
ax3.set_ylabel('Number of Transactions', fontsize=10)
ax3.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# 4. Sales by Size (Bottom left)
ax4 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 4)
size_order = ['Small', 'Medium', 'Large']
size_sales = df.groupby('size')['total'].sum()
size_sales_ordered = size_sales.reindex([x for x in size_order if x in size_sales.index])
ax4.bar(size_sales_ordered.index, size_sales_ordered.values, 
        color=['#FFE5B4', '#FFD700', '#FF8C00'])
ax4.set_title('Total Sales by Size', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_xlabel('Size', fontsize=10)
ax4.set_ylabel('Total Sales ($)', fontsize=10)

# 5. Takeaway vs Dine-in (Bottom middle)
ax5 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 5)
takeaway_sales = df.groupby('is_takeaway')['total'].sum()
labels = ['Dine-in', 'Takeaway']
colors_takeaway = ['#FF6B6B', '#4ECDC4']
ax5.pie(takeaway_sales.values, labels=labels, autopct='%1.1f%%', 
        colors=colors_takeaway, startangle=90)
ax5.set_title('Sales: Takeaway vs Dine-in', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')

# 6. Average Transaction Value by Age Group and Size (Bottom right)
ax6 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 6)
age_size_avg = df.groupby(['customer_age_group', 'size'])['total'].mean().unstack(fill_value=0)
age_size_avg_ordered = age_size_avg.reindex([x for x in age_order if x in age_size_avg.index])
age_size_avg_ordered.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax6, width=0.8)
ax6.set_title('Avg Transaction Value by Age & Size', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax6.set_xlabel('Age Group', fontsize=10)
ax6.set_ylabel('Average Transaction Value ($)', fontsize=10)
ax6.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)
ax6.legend(title='Size', fontsize=8)

# Overall title
fig.suptitle('Coffee Shop Sales Analytics Dashboard', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)

# Adjust layout
plt.tight_layout(rect=[0, 0, 1, 0.99])

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
